# algolia_ingestion_authentication (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an Algolia Ingestion authentication resource's metadata. The `input` credentials are redacted by the API and are therefore not exposed by this data source at all; use the algolia_ingestion_authentication resource to manage credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    algolia = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/algolia/algolia"
    }
  }
}

provider "algolia" {
  analytics_region = "us"
}

# Reads an existing authentication's metadata (name, type, platform,
# timestamps). The `input` credentials are never exposed by this data
# source: the Ingestion API redacts secret values, so there is nothing
# meaningful to return.
data "algolia_ingestion_authentication" "example" {
  authentication_id = "6c02aed6-9d1f-4fef-b2f6-9a5a3ea1e2f2"
}

output "authentication_name" {
  value = data.algolia_ingestion_authentication.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication_id` (String) Universally unique identifier (UUID) of the authentication resource to read.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date and time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for the resource. Equal to `authentication_id`.
- `name` (String) Descriptive name for the authentication resource.
- `platform` (String) Name of the ecommerce platform this authentication is scoped to, if any.
- `type` (String) Type of authentication.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time when the resource was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
